name: Fetters (Superior)
text:
This long bar has two cuffs that enclose a prisoner's ankles or wrists. Fetters apply a –20-foot circumstance penalty to Speed and disrupt any manipulate action the bound creature attempts unless it succeeds at a DC 11 Flat check. Freeing a creature from superior fetters requires 5 successful DC 43 Thievery check checks.

Effect: Fetters
